reading: Volodymyr Zelensky has accused the US of applying insufficient pressure on Russia and said delays in delivering essential defensive missiles were costing Ukrainian lives.
He also criticised Washington's emphasis on the Middle East, arguing that countries there were receiving greater assistance.
Zelensky expressed unease over Donald Trump's portrayal of Vladimir Putin as a friend in a post showing the two men embracing.
His criticism comes after a period of caution in managing US relations following a bruising Oval Office encounter with Trump in 2025.
The report describes the two US envoys seeking a peace deal as appearing more in tune with Moscow's position than Kyiv's.
The latest talks, mediated in Abu Dhabi, produced no obvious progress, according to the report.
Russia appears to have regressed to its initial hardline positions across the negotiating agenda, judging by its public statements.
Zelensky said it remained unclear whether European negotiators would be at the table, despite the US envoys having announced their participation.
He urged the US to live up to its reputation for strength and use its influence to push Russia towards results.
The US presents its neutrality as part of an effort to secure a peace agreement that can hold.
Zelensky said Ukraine could now destroy about 70% of Russia's fastest drones and that the proportion was improving.
He described a severe deficit of interceptors, missiles used to stop incoming ballistic missiles, and accused the US of delaying deliveries of Patriot systems.
Zelensky also confirmed that the US satellite communications systems Starlink and Starshield remained restricted in occupied Ukrainian territory.
Ukrainian drone units reported that some Russian drones were travelling farther into Ukraine unhindered because their interceptor drones could no longer catch them.
Ukraine has increased its long-range strikes on Russian targets, including oil refineries and ships carrying weapons or fuel.
While acknowledging that such strikes were highly dangerous, Zelensky said Ukrainian forces never conducted them without coordinating with partners.
Zelensky acknowledged that Ukraine was bracing for a difficult and dangerous winter.
Some residents had already left town for the winter and businesses had closed as power cuts and attacks on logistics networks pushed operating costs unmanageably high.

vocabulary.definition: Broadly aligned with someone's views or priorities, without necessarily having a formal agreement.
Conducted with a third party helping opposing sides seek an agreement.
Returned to an earlier, less constructive position after apparent movement away from it.
Unwilling to soften demands or make substantial compromises.
Participating directly in discussions where decisions or agreements are being negotiated.
Meet the expectations created by a reputation, promise or stated standard.
The amount by which what is available falls short of what is required.
Defensive missiles intended to destroy incoming missiles before they reach their targets.
Free from obstruction or interference that would prevent further progress.
Preparing mentally or practically for something expected to be difficult or unpleasant.
So high that those affected cannot cope with the financial burden.

entries.ja: 正式な合意があるとは限らないものの、相手の考えや優先事項とおおむね一致していること。
entries.ko: 반드시 공식적인 합의가 있는 것은 아니지만, 상대의 견해나 우선순위와 대체로 일치하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 与某人的观点或优先考虑的事项大体一致，但不一定有正式协议。
entries.es: Coincidir en términos generales con las opiniones o prioridades de alguien, sin que necesariamente exista un acuerdo formal.
entries.pt-BR: Estar, em linhas gerais, de acordo com as opiniões ou prioridades de alguém, sem necessariamente haver um acordo formal.
entries.fr: Être globalement en accord avec les opinions ou les priorités de quelqu’un, sans qu’il y ait nécessairement d’accord officiel.
entries.de: Mit den Ansichten oder Prioritäten einer Person weitgehend übereinstimmen, ohne dass unbedingt eine formelle Vereinbarung besteht.

entries.ja: 対立する双方が合意を目指せるよう、第三者の支援を受けて行われたこと。
entries.ko: 대립하는 양측이 합의를 모색하도록 제삼자의 도움을 받아 진행된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在第三方帮助对立双方寻求协议的情况下进行的。
entries.es: Llevado a cabo con la ayuda de una tercera parte que facilita que las partes enfrentadas busquen un acuerdo.
entries.pt-BR: Realizado com a ajuda de uma terceira parte que auxilia os lados em conflito a buscar um acordo.
entries.fr: Mené avec l’aide d’un tiers qui aide les parties opposées à rechercher un accord.
entries.de: Unter Mitwirkung einer dritten Partei durchgeführt, die die gegnerischen Seiten bei der Suche nach einer Einigung unterstützt.

entries.ja: 以前のあまり建設的でない立場から離れたように見えた後で、その立場に戻ったこと。
entries.ko: 이전의 덜 건설적인 입장에서 벗어나는 듯했으나, 이후 다시 그 입장으로 돌아간 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在看似已从先前较不具建设性的立场有所转变后，又退回了那个立场。
entries.es: Haber vuelto a una postura anterior y menos constructiva después de haberse alejado aparentemente de ella.
entries.pt-BR: Ter voltado a uma posição anterior e menos construtiva depois de aparentemente ter se afastado dela.
entries.fr: Être revenu à une position antérieure, moins constructive, après avoir semblé s’en éloigner.
entries.de: Zu einer früheren, weniger konstruktiven Position zurückgekehrt, nachdem man sich anscheinend von ihr entfernt hatte.

entries.ja: 要求を和らげたり、大幅な妥協をしたりする意思がないこと。
entries.ko: 요구를 완화하거나 상당한 타협을 할 의사가 없는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 不愿降低要求或作出实质性妥协的。
entries.es: Que no está dispuesto a moderar sus exigencias ni a hacer concesiones sustanciales.
entries.pt-BR: Sem disposição para moderar as exigências ou fazer concessões substanciais.
entries.fr: Qui refuse d’assouplir ses exigences ou de faire des compromis importants.
entries.de: Nicht bereit, Forderungen abzumildern oder wesentliche Kompromisse einzugehen.

entries.ja: 決定や合意に向けた交渉が行われる話し合いに、直接参加していること。
entries.ko: 결정이나 합의를 위한 협상이 이루어지는 논의에 직접 참여하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 直接参与就决策或协议进行协商的讨论。
entries.es: Participar directamente en conversaciones en las que se negocian decisiones o acuerdos.
entries.pt-BR: Participar diretamente de discussões em que decisões ou acordos estão sendo negociados.
entries.fr: Participer directement à des discussions au cours desquelles des décisions ou des accords sont négociés.
entries.de: Direkt an Gesprächen teilnehmen, in denen über Entscheidungen oder Vereinbarungen verhandelt wird.

entries.ja: 評判や約束、明示された基準によって生じた期待に応えること。
entries.ko: 평판이나 약속, 명시된 기준으로 인해 생긴 기대를 충족하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 达到声誉、承诺或明确提出的标准所带来的期望。
entries.es: Cumplir las expectativas generadas por una reputación, una promesa o un estándar declarado.
entries.pt-BR: Atender às expectativas criadas por uma reputação, uma promessa ou um padrão declarado.
entries.fr: Répondre aux attentes créées par une réputation, une promesse ou une norme annoncée.
entries.de: Die Erwartungen erfüllen, die durch einen Ruf, ein Versprechen oder einen ausdrücklich genannten Maßstab entstanden sind.

entries.ja: 必要な量に対して、利用できる量が不足している分。
entries.ko: 필요한 양에 비해 현재 이용 가능한 양이 모자라는 부분.
entries.zh-Hans: 现有数量与所需数量相比不足的部分。
entries.es: La cantidad que falta para que lo disponible alcance lo necesario.
entries.pt-BR: A quantidade que falta para que o que está disponível seja suficiente para atender ao necessário.
entries.fr: La quantité qui manque pour que les ressources disponibles couvrent les besoins.
entries.de: Die Menge, die fehlt, damit das Vorhandene den Bedarf deckt.

entries.ja: 飛来するミサイルを、目標に到達する前に破壊するための防御用ミサイル。
entries.ko: 날아오는 미사일이 목표물에 도달하기 전에 파괴하기 위한 방어용 미사일.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在来袭导弹到达目标之前将其摧毁的防御性导弹。
entries.es: Misiles defensivos destinados a destruir los misiles que se aproximan antes de que alcancen sus objetivos.
entries.pt-BR: Mísseis de defesa destinados a destruir mísseis que se aproximam antes que atinjam seus alvos.
entries.fr: Des missiles défensifs destinés à détruire les missiles en approche avant qu’ils n’atteignent leurs cibles.
entries.de: Abwehrraketen, die anfliegende Raketen zerstören sollen, bevor diese ihre Ziele erreichen.

entries.ja: さらに進むのを妨げる障害や干渉がないこと。
entries.ko: 계속 나아가는 것을 막을 장애물이나 방해가 없는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 没有阻止其继续前进的障碍或干扰的。
entries.es: Libre de obstáculos o interferencias que impidan seguir avanzando.
entries.pt-BR: Sem obstáculos ou interferências que impeçam continuar avançando.
entries.fr: Sans obstacle ni interférence qui empêcherait de continuer à avancer.
entries.de: Frei von Hindernissen oder Eingriffen, die ein weiteres Vorankommen verhindern würden.

entries.ja: 困難や不快さが予想されることに向けて、心の準備や実際の備えを進めていること。
entries.ko: 어렵거나 불쾌할 것으로 예상되는 일에 마음의 준비를 하거나 실질적으로 대비하고 있는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在为预计会困难或令人不快的事情做心理或实际准备。
entries.es: Estar preparándose mentalmente o tomando medidas prácticas para afrontar algo que se espera que sea difícil o desagradable.
entries.pt-BR: Estar se preparando mentalmente ou tomando medidas práticas para enfrentar algo que se espera que seja difícil ou desagradável.
entries.fr: Être en train de se préparer mentalement ou de prendre des dispositions concrètes pour affronter quelque chose qui s’annonce difficile ou désagréable.
entries.de: Sich gerade gedanklich oder durch praktische Maßnahmen auf etwas vorbereiten, das voraussichtlich schwierig oder unangenehm sein wird.

entries.ja: 影響を受ける人々が、その金銭的な負担に対応できないほど高いこと。
entries.ko: 영향을 받는 사람들이 그 금전적 부담을 감당할 수 없을 정도로 높은 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 高到受影响的人无法承受其经济负担的程度。
entries.es: Tan elevado que las personas afectadas no pueden hacer frente a la carga económica.
entries.pt-BR: Tão alto que as pessoas afetadas não conseguem arcar com o peso financeiro.
entries.fr: Si élevé que les personnes concernées ne peuvent pas faire face à la charge financière.
entries.de: So hoch, dass die Betroffenen die finanzielle Belastung nicht bewältigen können.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
